requiredBehaviors.behavior: treat intended use as a separate gate before technological comparison
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow contains an explicit Intended Use Gate before the technology matrix and does not allow technical similarity to compensate for a clearly different intended use.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: map each material technological difference to safety and effectiveness questions and supporting performance evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Different-Questions analysis and Performance Evidence Map link each material difference to safety/effectiveness questions, evidence and residual uncertainty.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat product-code equality or predicate clearance alone as proof of substantial equivalence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The core principles explicitly reject Product Code, Regulation Number or predicate clearance as sufficient SE proof.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: claim FDA clearance from an internal positive assessment
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: A positive internal assessment remains an SE-hypothesis until FDA issues an actual SE order.
